verdict.rationale: Figma's hosted MCP server enforces OAuth with a documented scope (`mcp:connect`) rather than an all-or-nothing token, and SCIM/admin role controls exist, showing some support for least-privilege access. However, there is no documented ability to mint fine-grained, scoped personal API tokens (e.g., read-only vs write, per-resource) specifically for an agent's REST/Plugin API use. Missing for 10: explicit scoped/permissioned personal access token creation UI or docs, granular scope list for REST/Plugin API credentials, and independent confirmation of least-privilege enforcement beyond the single MCP scope.
